h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bellary

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bellary

c: Bellary, or Ballari, is a mining and steel district in the dry interior of Karnataka. The townships around its steel plants and mines have many open spaces that suit an outdoor gym. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bellary to these townships, as well as to schools, colleges, municipal parks and residential layouts. We make the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 640 km away, and deliver it by road.

Iron ore dust is the local challenge. It settles on every surface and works its way into joints and bearings, and summers here are very hot. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic parts stand up to this better than painted steel. The rest depends on a cleaning routine. Assign one person to wipe down the machines weekly and keep moving parts free of grit. Afternoon shade matters too, because the sun is strong for most of the year and people will use the gym mainly early and late.

items.q: How do we look after outdoor gym equipment in a mining area?
items.a: Wipe the machines every week, keep moving joints clean and report any stiffness early. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts resist dust and rust better than painted steel.

items.q: Can you supply a steel plant township in Bellary?
items.a: Yes. Share the site plan or photos. We prepare a layout drawing and quote, manufacture at our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer.

items.q: What warranty applies to moving parts?
items.a: Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty, and galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Both cover manufacturing defects when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions.
